## Protect Your Home with Frontpoint's Customized Solutions

Property ProtectionFront Door ProtectionIndoor ProtectionFrontpoint AppHome Automation

### **Protect Your Property with Outdoor Cameras**

Keeping unwanted guests off your property is the first line of defense in keeping your home safe.
Armed with elevated deterrence capabilities, Frontpoint’s outdoor cameras can proactively warn
intruders (and you) even when you aren’t around.

Your browser does not support the video tag.

**Top notch surveillance and deterrence: **
Deter would be intruders with loud beeps and a flashing LED when a person or animal enters the
camera’s field of vision with Perimeter Guard ™.

**Latest technology in home protection:**
With AI Deterrence, you can add verbal messages that include details of the intruder and a verbal
warning to leave with your choice of voice and tone.

**Customized notifications:**
Set up customized rules with the help of Video Analytics so you only get video clips and
notifications about what’s important to you.

Your browser does not support the video tag.

**Rapid response: **
Respond to trouble in real time with rapid person detection. It notifies you when someone is at your
door and captures it on video- even in the dark.

**Home awareness: **
Know what is going on even when you aren’t home. Use the Frontpoint app to see who’s there without
opening the door or even having to get up. Easily monitor packages and visitor arrivals with custom
notifications.

**Stay connected: **
Use two-way audio capabilities to talk to whoever is at your door.

Your browser does not support the video tag.

**Instant response: **
A piercing alarm siren, app notifications and a call from our monitoring center ensure you’ll be
warned the moment trouble strikes.

**Top quality: **
Premium Alarm.com technology, top of the line support and the same backend technology as expensive
competitors provides long term value.

**Stay in control: **
Indoor cameras come equipped with two-way audio so you can keep tabs on intruders, kids, pets and
older parents.

Your browser does not support the video tag.

**Consolidated communication: **
With the Frontpoint app, all of your security needs are in one place. See live and recorded video
footage, arming activity, sensor activity and more.

**Easy set up: **
The equipment for your custom system is preconfigured for you to install on your own schedule. Set
up is a breeze with our set-up wizard and support team ready to help.

**Customized features: **
Use the Smart Arming feature to automatically arm/disarm based on custom rules or create a “Sleep
Scene” to lock your smart doorlock, turn off lights and arm your system with the click of a button.

Your browser does not support the video tag.

**Control access: **
Smart Door Locks can be programmed with unique and temporary entry codes. Great for giving access to
dog walkers, repair workers, guests and kids.

**Work smarter: **
Lock up without getting locked out. Unlock your Smart Door Lock from the door keypad or while you
are on vacation with the Frontpoint app.

**Don’t get left in the dark: **
Create custom schedules with Frontpoint’s Smart Plugs to save energy and never come home to a dark
house.

$749.99 expenditure on equipment (after discounts), professional installation and execution of a

financing partners. Qualified customers may finance at 0% APR for up to 60 months, with terms
varying by offer. Financing requires a separate agreement with the financing partner. Month-to-month
service agreements are available when equipment is purchased upfront.

# Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification | ACSMI Online Training

The [Advanced Cybersecurity Management Institute (ACSMI)][90] provides professional cybersecurity
certification and management training online. ACSMI is NOT affiliated with the American College of
Sports Medicine (ACSM) — we are a dedicated cybersecurity education organization focused on
multi-domain security training.

Earn your Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification (ACSMC) through our CPD-accredited and
ACE college credit-recognized program. Whether you're a [career changer][91], IT professional, or
[aspiring CISO][92], this comprehensive cybersecurity training program delivers the skills employers
demand.

This CPD-accredited and ACE college credit recognized online cybersecurity certification is designed
to bridge the gap between theory and real-world skills. Gain new career opportunities with our
professional cybersecurity certification that provides affordable yet high-quality training across
industries and skillsets to preserve lifetime career success and easier career pivots.

cybersecurity and management certification with a red 'Enroll Instantly' button, logos, and trainer
photos.] ][94]

**✔** Led by Janero Washington with 10+ Years of Cybersecurity Teaching Expertise
**✔** Risk-Free 14-Day Refund, Lifetime Access, Flexible Payment Plans & Mentorship
**✔** Real-World Cybersecurity Cases, Labs, Simulations, and Capstone
**✔** Preparation for Certification Exams While Gaining Career Confidence Across Roles
**✔** Fast-Track (8 Weeks) or Self-Paced (Up to 6 Months) Study Options

## What You Will Master in ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification

Cybersecurity isn’t just a career path anymore, it’s a frontline battle. With ACSMI’s
[Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification][95]. You learn how to outthink,
outmaneuver, and outlast the next generation of cyber threats.
**Inside 300+ carefully crafted lessons, you’ll master:**

### You won’t just know cybersecurity, you’ll command it.

Lead cyber investigations, recover breached systems, and present bulletproof forensic evidence —
just like top SOCs worldwide.

#### Information Security and Data Protection

Command identity management, cryptography, and GDPR/CCPA-grade data defense — the skillset every
future-ready organization demands.

[icon]

#### Malware Analysis and Reverse Engineering

Deconstruct malware and protect digital ecosystems from quantum-era cyberweapons.

[icon]

#### Cybersecurity in Specialized Sectors

Dominate critical sector cybersecurity: healthcare, aviation, maritime, smart cities, and more.

[icon]

#### Cloud Security and Virtual Environments

Build resilient cloud infrastructures across AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments — fully compliant,
fully secure

[icon]

#### Ethical Hacking and Penetration Testing

Deconstruct malware and protect digital ecosystems from quantum-era cyberweapons.

[icon]

#### Foundations of Cybersecurity

Build indestructible knowledge in threat landscapes, frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001), and legal/ethical
operations

[icon]

#### Endpoint, Cloud, and Application Security

Fortify endpoints, cloud-native apps, containers, and serverless architectures against relentless
attacks.

[icon]

#### Network Security and Infrastructure Protection

Architect, harden, and defend 5G, cloud, and enterprise networks with firewalls, IDPS, VPNs, and
Zero Trust models.

[icon]

#### Threat Intelligence and Threat Hunting

Detect, isolate, and eradicate advanced threats with real-world APT simulations and machine-learning
enhanced threat hunting.

Our smart security cameras let you see, hear, and speak from the Blink Home Monitor app. Experience
HD day and night video, two way audio, motion detection, and more. Get up to two years of battery
life* with our wire-free devices.

Featuring next-level 2K clarity, enhanced audio, plus an easy wireless setup, our next-generation
Outdoor 2K+ gives you complete security for your view, your way. No wires. No worries. No
compromises.

### **New** Outdoor 2K+

[ Learn more ][74]

Mini camera, max performance. Mini 2K+ is our third-generation compact plug-in camera, featuring
sharp 2K video resolution and expansive coverage that captures every detail in stunning clarity.

### **New** Mini 2K+

[ Learn more ][75]

180° panoramic live view with a Blink Plus Plan (sold separately). Two cameras. One power source.
Complete coverage.

life, an expanded field of view, and improved security features for more peace of mind, no matter
where you are.

# Whole home coverage starts here

Our smart security cameras let you see, hear, and speak from the Blink Home Monitor app. Experience
HD day and night video, two way audio, motion detection, and more. Get up to two years of battery
life* with our wire-free devices.

Featuring next-level 2K clarity, enhanced audio, plus an easy wireless setup, our next-generation
Outdoor 2K+ gives you complete security for your view, your way. No wires. No worries. No
compromises.

### **New** Outdoor 2K+

[ Learn more ][74]

Mini camera, max performance. Mini 2K+ is our third-generation compact plug-in camera, featuring
sharp 2K video resolution and expansive coverage that captures every detail in stunning clarity.

### **New** Mini 2K+

[ Learn more ][75]

Blink Arc is a compact, weather-resistant mount that connects two Blink Mini 2K+ cameras, delivering
180° panoramic live view with a Blink Plus Plan (sold separately). Two cameras. One power source.
Complete coverage.

### **New** Blink Arc

[ Learn more ][76]

Video Doorbell is our second-generation smart security doorbell with up to two years of battery
life, an expanded field of view, and improved security features for more peace of mind, no matter
where you are.

### Video Doorbell

[ Learn more ][77]

“We were minutes away from losing our memories, our home, and most concerning, our precious dog
babies. Get yourself a camera... changed the course of my life.”

#### — Monica S., Blink Customer

## Blink and you’re home

[Blink Home Monitor App]

### See, hear, and speak from anywhere

The Blink Home Monitor app connects your home to your phone for the ultimate peace of mind. With
multi-system support, you can use Blink to help watch over your home, vacation home, or business all
at the same time. Plus, control multiple Blink systems in one app.

[Learn more][78]
[Alexa-enabled Devices]

### Do more with Alexa

Go hands free with select Alexa-enabled devices! Be alerted when motion is detected, stream live
video, speak to visitors with two-way talk, create helpful routines, and so much more. Features may
vary upon setup and device type.

[Learn more][79]

## Smart security designed for every home

Bring peace of mind home with Blink indoor and outdoor devices

[ Shop now ][80]

*Battery life will vary based on device settings, use, and environmental factors.

## Sustainability,
## made standard

Helping sustainability move from aspiration to operation across facilities, infrastructure, and
natural systems

[Learn more][102]

## Who we are

Bluetooth® is more than just a technology. The Bluetooth Special Interest Group (SIG) is a community
of some of the most inventive minds and organizations with the shared vision of creating a better
world through connection. Together, we advance, protect, and promote Bluetooth® technology, the
global standard for connection.

## Advance

We are an international standards development organization. We continually enhance Bluetooth®
technology by creating new specifications that push the boundaries of what’s possible and help make
the world a better place.

## Protect

We are a product certification body. We operate a world-class product qualification program that
promotes global interoperability and provides access to Bluetooth technology patent and trademark
licenses.

## Promote

We are a global trade association. We collaborate to increase the awareness, understanding, and
adoption of Bluetooth technology.

[Learn more][103]

Find out how this new Bluetooth® capability will deliver life-changing audio experiences that will
enhance the way you engage with others and the world around you.

## Who we are

Bluetooth® is more than just a technology. The Bluetooth Special Interest Group (SIG) is a community
of some of the most inventive minds and organizations with the shared vision of creating a better
world through connection. Together, we advance, protect, and promote Bluetooth® technology, the
global standard for connection.

## Advance

We are an international standards development organization. We continually enhance Bluetooth®
technology by creating new specifications that push the boundaries of what’s possible and help make
the world a better place.

## Protect

We are a product certification body. We operate a world-class product qualification program that
promotes global interoperability and provides access to Bluetooth technology patent and trademark
licenses.

## Promote

We are a global trade association. We collaborate to increase the awareness, understanding, and
adoption of Bluetooth technology.
